title: Perimeter Scan
caption: Perimeter Scan (V)
game_text: If two related unique (•) sites are on table, ▼ the related system. OR Peek at a face down card on table. OR If a character or starship’s power was just reduced, reset that card’s power to its printed power for remainder of turn.
lore: “It’s a good bet the Empire knows we’re here.”
